name: Answer one audience question directly
short_description: Answer one audience question directly once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can answer one audience question directly in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Answer one audience question directly means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Answer one audience question directly in a fresh real-life scenario.
